shaderInterpretation: Published fragment SPIR-V: load input color (id18), sample texture (OpImageSampleImplicitLod 87 id28), OpFMul 133 (id29 = id18 * id28), store to output id9. No sRGB/gamma or premultiply instruction. Pipeline SrcColorBlendFactor=6 (SRC_ALPHA), DstColorBlendFactor=7 (ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA), SrcAlphaBlendFactor=1 (ONE), DstAlphaBlendFactor=7. Therefore upload straight-linear UNORM pixels and straight-linear palette tint. sRGB swapchain encodes only after blending. SDL white mask normalizes RGB=255 including zero-alpha texels to avoid dark filtering fringes.
